entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Reachable assert in CertificateRevocationListBuilder.LoadPem with trailing data #122823
  • Design of the Unix implementation of the new Process APIs #122819
    11.0.0
  • Feature Proposal: Practical Non-breaking Constant Generics #122818
  • System.Linq.Parallel is missing optimizations for IReadOnlyList<T> and IReadOnlyCollection<T> #122817

Closed

  • Undefined behaviour when using PInvoke & dateTime.Day on .NET9+ #122826

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix trailing data handling with CertificateRevocationListBuilder.LoadPem. #122825
    area-System.Security
  • Consolidate GC.AddMemoryPressure/RemoveMemoryPressure implementation between NativeAOT and CoreCLR #122824
  • Optimize AllocHeap: use new/delete with 4KB blocks and static allocation #122822
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Add III.1.7 "Managed pointers exposing parameters outside of the method scope" to Ecma-335-Augments.md #122821
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Skip empty sections when calculating a R2R PE file layout #122820
    area-crossgen2-coreclr
  • Remove managed implementation from SP800-108 on Windows #122816
    area-System.Security

Merged

  • Rename AsyncSafeThreadMap to SignalSafeThreadMap #122794
    area-VM-coreclr
  • Consolidate runtime helpers (X86Base, Interlocked, Buffer) across CoreCLR and NativeAOT #122791
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr

    needs-area-label
  • Split GetInterpThreadContext into allocating and non-allocating variants #122688
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr
  • Move RBM_SAVED_LOCALLOC_SP reservation from compCompile to setFrameType in LSRA #121745
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [RISC-V] Comment and formatting cleanup in `codegenriscv64` #122589
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution, arch-riscv

Updated

  • Intrinsify Span.Slice(int,int) for Span[X..] #122065
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Fix FromBase64Transform buffer sizing and output buffer handling #122805
    area-System.Security
  • Generate calls to interface methods through resolve helper #122639
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • [wasm][coreclr] Fix struct layout #122704
    arch-wasm, area-TypeSystem-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Fix interpreter ResumeAfterCatch on arm64 Unix #122504
    area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • ILC: track concrete dependencies of open generic methods #122012
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • JIT: Zero continuation return after profiler leave callback #122490
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Fix some memory leaks in mono #122784

  • Fix Mono Debugger 200ms Pause (Issue #122344) #122449
